newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguayan Feb inflation 1.64 pct - official.
newsitem.headline: Uruguayan Feb inflation 1.64 pct - official.

text.p: Uruguayan consumer prices rose 1.64 percent in February, against rises of 1.50 percent in February 1996 and 2.00 percent in January this year, the Statistics Institute said Wednesday.
In the 12 months to February, consumer prices rose 24.50 percent, down from 33.59 percent in the 12 months to February 1995, the institute said.
Uruguay reported an inflation rate of 24.30 percent in 1996, and seeks to end 1997 with a rate between 14.00 an 17.00 percent.
